node: Grid EPC, transmission construction, and utility services
summary: Expanded the universe around the grid EPC and line-construction execution layer with a two-lane funnel. Quanta Services is retained only as the reference anchor for backlog and customer-demand context. The underfollowed lane prioritizes smaller US-listed utility contractors and a niche transmission-hardware supplier that can sit upstream of visible construction revenue. Key chokepoint logic: electric utility capex can be delayed by permitting, labor availability, lineworker capacity, and long-lead hardware; therefore backlog, MSA growth, T&D segment revenue, and hardware order intake are the first evidence fields to verify in later layers.
